summary: Verification of session 2 features: (1) CRM SSO return path Hermes WebUI -> Next.js/FastAPI Admin, (2) 9router full model integration + phantom provider cleanup, (3) regression of DIN API aliases and NL i18n. Combined results: testing_agent partial run (TEST 2, TEST 3) + main-agent self-tests (TEST 1, 4, 5, 6 - agent was cut off before completing). ALL 6 TESTS PASS.

test_details.TEST1_crm_sso_browser_e2e: PASS (main agent, playwright): login webui.nexifyai.cloud -> click [data-testid='webui-crm-tab'] -> same-tab redirect -> https://www.nexifyai.cloud/admin shows NeXify Cockpit logged in (23 Leads, 7 Angebote, EUR 25.974 Pipeline).
test_details.TEST2_sso_security_curl: PASS 5/5 (testing_agent): /crm 302 with one-time token; first consume 302 /admin + HttpOnly Secure access/refresh cookies; replay 302 /login?sso=invalid; fake token 302 /login?sso=invalid; /crm without session leaks no token.
test_details.TEST3_9router_models: PASS 2/2 (testing_agent): /api/models/live count=21 via custom:ai-router.nexifyai.cloud; providers with has_key=true exactly ['custom:ai-router.nexifyai.cloud','xiaomi'] - phantom openai/openai-api cards gone.
test_details.TEST4_webui_chat_stream: PASS (main agent, playwright): message 'Antworte nur mit: OK' -> streamed reply 'OK' at 13.2 t/s via ds/deepseek-chat (9router). No 'Model not found'/'No active credentials' errors.
test_details.TEST5_din_alias_regression: PASS (main agent, curl after container recreate): /api/tasks, /api/agents, /api/brain?limit=1, /api/kanban/board all 200 with session; 401 without.
test_details.TEST6_nl_i18n_regression: PASS (main agent, curl): /static/i18n.js contains _label: 'Nederlands' (1290 keys), served fresh via version-stamped asset URLs.
